location_name: Territorial sea and adjacent continental shelf of the Republic of China
summary: President Chiang Kai-shek promulgated the Statute for the Exploration and Exploitation of Petroleum in Offshore Areas, which asserted ROC authority to explore and exploit petroleum and natural gas in the ROC territorial sea and the continental shelf adjacent to it, through state-owned petroleum enterprises alone or with foreign partners.
actors: President Chiang Kai-shek; Executive Yuan (Premier Yen Chia-kan); Ministry of Economic Affairs (Sun Yun-suan); Chinese Petroleum Corporation (state petroleum enterprise)
